title: Whispering Palms | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning home!* Gulfview Heights Beach Access- 880 Yards away!* Golf cart included with your reservation — no deposit required* 4 Included Bikes* Jetted Tub, Flatscreen, and Balcony Access in Master* Balcony overlooking Pool!*
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning home!* Gulfview Heights Beach Access- 880 Yards away!* Golf cart included with your reservation — no deposit required* 4 Included Bikes* Jetted Tub, Flatscreen, and Balcony Access in Master* Balcony overlooking Pool!* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Walk to Goatfeathers Rest., Local Catch Bar and Grill + local shops* 0.7 miles to Gulf Place: Perfect Pig, Shunk Gulley and more* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.*Whispering Palms is a recently updated 3BR, 2.5BA beach house located just off the quiet west end of Scenic Highway 30A in Gulfview Heights, between Blue Mountain Beach and Gulf Place. You’ll be only steps from the sparkling community pool and about 880 yards to the beach access! This home boasts hardwood floors throughout, modern designs, 10ft ceilings, and a fully equipped kitchen with granite counters and stainless-steel appliances. The first floor's open living area feature the living room with sleeper sofa, dining, kitchen, half bath and washer/dryer. Upstairs, the 3 bedrooms include a gorgeous Queen master with en suite bath (includes a jetted tub) and balcony overlooking the community pool, a bedroom with a full bed, and a bunk room with 2 bunk beds, sleeping a total of 11 guests comfortably! Splash around in the community pool, take a stroll to the beach, or check out Gulf Place Town Center under a mile away. Make Whispering Palms your next beach vacation tradition!Beach Nest is a small community of coastal homes accented with upscale touches. Ideally located in Gulfview Heights, close to Gulf Place on the west side Hwy 30A. Beach Nest features a lovely gated community pool for guests to enjoy. Take a stroll to Gulfview Heights beach access or dine at some local favorites only a block or two away. Come experience the Beach Nest community and see why you’ll be returning year after year!The Bed Setup:1st FloorLiving Room: Sleeper Sofa2nd FloorMaster bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Full BedGuest Bedroom: Twin Bunk and Twin over Full BunkArea Attractions: Whispering Palms is perfectly situated, with Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Located in an upscale area of Hwy 30A, this pristine house is perched in between Destin and Seaside. Just a 13-minute drive to Grand Boulevard Town Center with over 35 shops and restaurant as well as the all-new state-of-the-art Boulevard 10 Movie Theater. Bike down to Blue Mountain Creamery for a cone or meander along the miles of trails! The Gulf Place community is located along a 26-mile stretch of sugar-white sand and turquoise waters of Northwest Florida’s celebrated Emerald Coast. As one of the 16 distinct beach neighborhoods in South Walton, it has its own distinct character and charm. This colorful community on 30A is comprised of 25 acres located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach on the corner of 30A and 393. Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow visitors and locals down with palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, colorful outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, green spaces and ample park benches to sit and enjoy the views. Gulf Place is unique from all the other South Walton neighborhoods. Residents and guests gather here to enjoy original art, boutique shopping, local cuisine, live music and a laid back atmosphere. 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
